name: Neyuki no Gen'ei -Shirahanasou no Hitobito-
original_name: 根雪の幻影 -白花荘の人々-
source:
This is the first title by SILKY’s PLUS A5 Wagyuu. Shigeaki used to be a carefree womanizer until he met Kaho, whom he immediately felt destined to be with. It took over a year to convince her to be his girlfriend, so he has grown to love her above any other girl. He is certain that he would not meet another girl better than her.

To celebrate their beginning as a couple, they visited the Western-style boarding house Shirahana-sou in the mountains. They were greeted by the beautiful Touko, who used to be the dorm mother when the building was a dormitory of the missionary girls’ school that Kaho graduated from. After some pleasant chatter, they were led by Touko’s daughter Kikyou to their room. The guest room was quite well made and felt almost luxurious. He had planned to just spend a relaxing time with Kaho in the mountains, but it seems like he would be able to enjoy this vacation more than he had envisioned.

That was what he innocently thought at that time. He could not have imagined that they would soon be caught in a world far away from their normal days.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/06/06/june-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是SILKY'S PLUS A5和牛的首部作品。重明曾是逍遥花花公子，直到遇见华穂，并立刻认定她是命中注定之人。他花了一年多才说服她成为女友，因此比爱其他女孩更深爱她，确信不会再遇到比她更好的女孩。

为了庆祝交往，两人来到山中的西式寄宿屋白花庄。美丽的藤子迎接他们，她曾在此建筑作为传教士女子学校宿舍时担任宿舍管理员，而华穂正是该校毕业生。愉快交谈后，藤子的女儿桔梗带他们来到房间。客房装修精美，几乎奢华。他本想只与华穂在山中度过悠闲时光，却发现假期似乎比想象更精彩。

当时他天真地这么想，完全没想到两人很快会被卷入远离日常生活的世界。

[译自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/06/06/june-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
